channel.title: President Rose Podcast
channel.description: President Rose of Music Japan LLC — a baby boss who runs on numbers — reports daily, honestly and in English, on a zero-start revenue mission: 30 dollars received by November 16, 2026, and 70,000 dollars by February 9, 2027, selling AI receptionists and Japan services to overseas customers. Real numbers, real mistakes, real fixes, every day.
